newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's troubled Kia seeks sell-offs, mergers.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's troubled Kia seeks sell-offs, mergers.

text.p: The troubled Kia Group, South Korea's eighth-largest conglomerate, will cut its affiliates to 14 from 28 through mergers and sell-offs, a company spokesman said on Wednesday.

Spokesman Jeun Sang-jin said the group would sell off assets totalling 1.9 trillion won. Group assets currently total 14.6 trillion won. The group would also trim its 56,000-strong workforce by 4,300.
"We will seek a strong self-rescue package, including slimming the group's size and workforce," Jeun said.
Jeun did not give any timetable or offer any other details.
Local banks decided on Tuesday to bail out the Kia Group, whose vehicle-making units had been battered by slumping sales. Its woes were compounded by persistent bankruptcy rumours.
